{{Top|leg}}
A '''scent mask''' was a type of [[Orfite]] apparatus manufactured by the [[Orfa Olfactory Corporation]]. It consisted of a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] connected via small tube to a belt unit. The unit held a half-liter of [[Water/Legends|water]] and was designed to accept small tablets, that it used to form the mask's inhalant. Though scent masks were designed to create complex [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromone]] entertainments for Orfites, many intoxicant tablets have been produced that had made them popular across the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].
